info.name: Harpaviljongen API
info.description:
Requests for the features used by the new admin.

1. Pick the environment "Harpaviljongen – Local" (or Production) top right.
2. Fill in username and password in the environment.
3. Run "Auth → Login". The token is saved automatically and used by every other request.

All GETs are public. POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE need the token.

"7. Användare" needs a user with the role admin.
